svg.aria-label: Active mask of every instruction of a diverging warp
svg.title: Active mask of every instruction of a diverging warp
svg.text: Divergence in kernels/03_divergence.psa: every instruction warp 0 issued, in order
Each row is one issue of one instruction. Each column is one lane (thread 0 to 7). From the RTL trace.
Warp 0 issued 31 instructions = 248 lane slots, of which 160 did useful work (65% SIMD efficiency).
